tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything. Dreamlight and Idol Stage are dark packs; Anime Sky and Toon Pop are light.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the question card, menus.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted panels laid over Muse Image art (pair with backdrop-filter blur 16px). Text on it uses ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on surface, surface-raised and surface-glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, evidence notes on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, active quest node, selected chip, links on surface.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Pack's second hue: tags, progress fill, decorative highlights. Never body text.

tokens.name: on-accent-2
tokens.usage: Text on an accent-2 fill.

tokens.name: reward
tokens.usage: Rewards only: collect buttons, mastered stars, unlock moments, the Treasure badge.

tokens.name: on-reward
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a reward fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Quiet dividers and decorative card edges. Never a control boundary.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and control boundaries, unselected chips (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid with a 2px offset (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct-answer chip fill; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Try-again chip fill; gentle, never red. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and behind text set directly on art.

tokens.name: kix-lavender
tokens.usage: Brand constant: Kix's body colour. Same in every pack.

tokens.name: kix-mint
tokens.usage: Brand constant: Kix's lower body. Same in every pack.

tokens.name: star-gold
tokens.usage: Brand constant: the sparkle in the wordmark and on Kix's forehead.

tokens.name: twilight
tokens.usage: Brand constant: wordmark ink on light grounds, app-icon ground.

styles.name: junior-display
styles.usage: One headline per screen. Swaps to the pack's display face.

styles.name: junior-body
styles.sample: Shine the torch at each block, then pick the one that makes no shadow.

styles.name: teen-display
styles.usage: Screen headline. Swaps to the pack's display face.

styles.name: teen-title
styles.sample: Resultant force on a moving cart

styles.name: teen-body
styles.sample: Two forces act on the cart. Find the resultant and state its direction.

styles.name: dreamlight-display
styles.usage: Display face when data-theme is dreamlight.

styles.name: anime-sky-display
styles.usage: Display face when data-theme is anime-sky.

styles.name: toon-pop-display
styles.usage: Display face when data-theme is toon-pop.

styles.name: idol-stage-display
styles.usage: Display face when data-theme is idol-stage.

styles.name: terrarium-display
styles.usage: Display face when data-theme is terrarium.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Teen card padding; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Junior card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section gap on tablet.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between screen regions.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room over art.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small tags. Anime Sky uses this for cards too (crisper pack).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, teen cards, answer options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Junior cards, question card, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Collectible holo cards, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, quest nodes, progress bars.

shadow.note: Each pack expresses depth differently: soft dusk shadow, light sky shadow, hard clay offset, stage blackout.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised cards and the question card.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Reward and active-node glow only. Never on ordinary cards.

duration.note: Motion timing. Exits run at about 70% of the enter.

tokens.name: duration-snappy
tokens.usage: Press squash, toggles, hover.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels, card flips, chip changes.

tokens.name: duration-hero
tokens.usage: Reward fly-to-Treasure arc, pack re-skin view transition.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: Aurora hue drift and lantern rise loops in Treasure and Home only.

tokens.name: ease-soft
tokens.usage: Default enter easing.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Junior band rewards and Kix reactions. Not for Teen.

tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in the Junior band.

tokens.name: target-teen
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in the Teen band.

tokens.usage: Kix as a corner companion (Teen default).
